name: visual-dictionary
description: UX/UI design-quality dictionary for agents: how interfaces look and behave. Routes vague design language to canonical terms, tunable dials, contracts, behavior rules, and vetted implementations with their licence and stack terms. Installs the MCP server and the router skill.

args: cd "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" && { [ -d node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/sdk ] || npm ci --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --silent >&2; } && exec node server.mjs
